thread:
Ava Ruiz: Quick sync 15m on Sparkflow newsletter + nurture. Goal: drive webinar RSVPs + benchmark reads, but test heavy personalization for top accounts. Doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/sparkflow-newsletter-v1
Marta Chen: Love the personalization test. Proposal: 3 cohorts = VIP accounts (top 250 by ARR), product users (active engagers), and broad list (all opt-ins). VIPs get 1:1 tone + account-specific stat.
Sanjay Patel: Good. We need precise exports. VIP list will be maintained from CRM tag = "spark_vip". Product users = opened OR clicked 30d. Broad = remaining opt-ins minus suppressions.
Ben Ortiz: Template plan: dynamic blocks:
- VIP block with account stat token
- regional time & webinar link
- progressive disclosure: short preview for mobile
I'll FYI the template will support AMP where available, fallback plain-text first.
Leo Novak: Send windows: test 10am local vs 2pm local for NA; EU at 11am local; APAC at 9am local. We'll shard by region+hash(user_id)%10 and stagger by 5m.
Olivia Tran: Deliverability note: For VIPs we should use dedicated IP pool to maximize inboxing. Also run seed tests per ISP before full send.
deliverability-bot: Current recommendation: NA/EU default throttle 2500 msgs/min; APAC initial 1800 msgs/min. Dedicated IP available for VIP pool if requested. See: https://ops.redwood.ai/deliverability/pools
Marta Chen: Copy plan:
- VIP: personalized headline, customer quote specific to their industry
- Product users: technical hooks + one benchmark stat (latency/cost)
- Broad: benefit-first, light benchmark, clear CTA to webinar or blog
A/B subject tests per cohort. Keep preheader <85 chars.
Sanjay Patel: SQL snippet for product users:
```
SELECT user_id,email FROM users WHERE email_opt_in=true AND (last_opened_at > now() - interval '30 days' OR last_clicked_at > now() - interval '30 days') AND not_in_suppression_list = true;
```
Ben Ortiz: Add header X-Redwood-Mail: sparkflow-q2 and UTM utm_medium=email&utm_source=sparkflow&utm_campaign=spark_q2_v1. Ensure DKIM/SPF aligned on staging.
Leo Novak: Send cap: max 1 marketing send per account in 7 days. Suppress trial_starts <= 90d, unsubscribed, enterprise_exclude list, and any support_critical flags. Also remove anyone who RSVP'd earlier.
Marta Chen: For VIP dynamic content, we'll require a CSV of account_stats: account_id, metric_value, short_quote. I'll upload to the drive by EOD.
Olivia Tran: For VIPs we'll also include a small invite-to-demo CTA that maps to an SDR queue. Track source via lead_source=vip_newsletter.
Sanjay Patel: KPI targets: VIP RSVP rate 12%, product users webinar sign 6%, broad open 20% CTR 3.5%. Dashboard: marketing.sparkflow.q2. Alerts if bounce>0.4% or open <10%.
Ben Ortiz: ETA: template draft tomorrow EOD. I'll run 3 smoke tests: NA/EU/APAC seeds (50 each) and VIP dedicated-IP seed (10). Will post results and seed heatmap.
Ava Ruiz: Nice. Also want a test for personalization fallback: ensure if account stat missing we show generic stat text. Marta, can you add fallback copy?
Marta Chen: Yes. Fallback line: "See how teams reduced inference cost by 3x in real workloads." Keeps tone credible.
Leo Novak: Note for ops: enable rate-limit override for VIP pool for first 10 minutes so SDR links populate quickly, but cap overall throughput.
deliverability-bot: Approved: VIP pool override permitted up to 6000 msgs/min for first 10m, then default back to 2500. Monitor bounces closely.
Sanjay Patel: I'll coordinate export + CRM tagging and confirm SDR mapping for VIP clicks.
Ben Ortiz: I'll also add a pixel to distinguish VIP click->RSVP vs broad click->RSVP for attribution.
Ava Ruiz: Actions:
- Marta: upload account_stats CSV + final copy (EOD)
- Ben: template + seeds + smoke + pixel (tomorrow EOD)
- Sanjay: final exports & CRM tags (tomorrow AM)
- Leo: shard plan + VIP rate override configs (tomorrow)
- Olivia: confirm VIP SDR routing mapping (tomorrow)
I'll run final go/no-go Monday AM. Tag me when seeds pass. :rocket:
